extracted.name: Plum Kuchen
extracted.description: This plum kuchen recipe is a German coffee cake made with fresh plums, topped with a buttery cinnamon crumble, and takes only 15 minutes to prepare.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 7x11-inch baking dish.

Beat ½ cup sugar and 2 tablespoons butter together in a bowl with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy. Add 1 cup flour, eggs, baking powder, and salt. Beat in vanilla. Pour batter into the prepared baking dish. Add plums, skin side down, over top.
Mix 1 cup sugar, ½ cup flour, 3 tablespoons melted butter, and cinnamon together in a separate bowl until crumbly: spoon over batter and plums.
Bake in the preheated oven until plums are softened, about 35 minutes.
